recipe.title: Sheet-Pan Taco Chicken & Veggies with Bone Broth Mexican Rice
recipe.summary: Taco-seasoned sheet-pan chicken with roasted red and green peppers, onions, and flavorful Mexican rice cooked with chicken bone broth.
recipe.story: This is designed as a family-size sheet-pan dinner with a clear 40/400 serving guide. The chicken and vegetables roast together while the Mexican rice cooks with bone broth instead of water for extra flavor and protein.
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds boneless skinless chicken breast, sliced lengthwise into strips
2 tablespoons Simple Truth Organic Extra Virgin Olive Oil
instructions: Add the chicken, red and green bell peppers, onion, and garlic to a large sheet pan.
Drizzle with the olive oil, sprinkle with the taco seasoning, and toss until evenly coated.
Spread into an even layer and roast for 18 to 22 minutes, tossing the vegetables halfway through, until the chicken reaches 165°F internally.
Meanwhile, prepare the Knorr Mexican Rice according to package directions using 1 1/2 cups chicken bone broth instead of water and omitting the oil called for on the package.
For each serving, plate approximately 4 1/2 ounces cooked chicken, 4 ounces cooked peppers and onions, and 1/2 cup prepared bone-broth Mexican rice.
tips: Weigh the cooked chicken and vegetables for the closest match to the listed serving macros.
Use chicken bone broth in place of the Knorr package water and omit the package oil.
Nutrition is approximate and may vary with cooking yield and exact vegetable sizes.

images.image_prompt: A realistic high-protein dinner bowl with sliced taco-seasoned chicken breast, roasted red and green bell peppers, and yellow onion with lightly browned caramelized edges. Serve beside approximately 1/2 cup Mexican-style seasoned rice made from long-grain rice and thin vermicelli. IMPORTANT: the rice must visually resemble the rice shown on a classic Knorr Mexican Rice package: warm golden-orange to tan seasoned rice, distinct long-grain rice mixed with visible short toasted vermicelli pieces, and tiny flecks of tomato, red pepper, parsley, and seasoning. The rice should look moist, fluffy, and lightly glossy. It must not look like plain brown rice, white rice, or Spanish rice with large tomato chunks. No avocado, cheese, sour cream, tortillas, or other unlisted ingredients.
